snippet.title: Playdate - I'm making a an Action RPG Game via the Pulp Editor - Oh My
snippet.description:
Playdate - I'm making a an Action RPG Game via the Pulp Editor - Oh My #playdate #videogames #retrogaming 

I always want to make my own game, a game I wanted to play, well this is my first ever game and I am doing it for charity.  It will be free for anyone! This is the start of the journey! 

Hi everybody, I am the EverCanadian and this channel is primarily dedicated to all things Evercade, the  Evercade community and to spread powerful positive vibes in video games. I also do content on a wide range of other retro and handheld devices!  So join me as we celebrate being gamers and fans of Video Games!
I am all about having fun and friendly dialogue in the comments section, if anyone is using it to troll, harrass, bully or start silly stupid arguments I will ban you right away.  Lets be better than that shyte!
